newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen opening higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen opening higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open higher on Wednesday, buoyed by rising bond prices, a stronger dollar and President Bill Clinton's State of the Union speech.
"What we'll expect is a good feeling in the market and that should lead us to a higher opening," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments.
However, investors will be keeping an eye on the Federal Open Market Committee meeting in case it raises interest rates. The two-day meeting ends on Wednesday.
